title: Kohler 27121-4-CP Parallel Two-Handle Deck-Mount Bath Faucet, Polished Chrome

comparisons.notes: Same model K-27121-4-CP polished chrome, 20 in stock

writeup: Kohler's Parallel two-handle deck-mount bath faucet in polished chrome is new at Woot for $387.99, about half of the $781.83 Lowe's price and $781.84 at Kitchen and Bath Authority for the same 27121-4-CP. It fills at up to 10 gpm, has an 8-1/4 inch spout reach and two lever handles. Woot showed only one left.
